title: Forgotten Hollow Guide: Quests, Monsters and Maps (Lv 39-60)
intro: Forgotten Hollow exists nowhere else in MapleStory: 15 quests, a cave fairy town, ten new monsters and the Rotten Mushmom boss.

blocks.p: [[img:99e27e8c542fc6.png]] Forgotten Hollow is a brand-new area that exists nowhere else in MapleStory. It's a cave with its own fairy town, ten new monsters, the Rotten Mushmom boss and 15 quests. The story starts at level 39 with Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia. It ends with him too.
**Forgotten Hollow is closed during Founder's Access.** Nexon's release notes for October 6 say the path there has not been discovered yet, and the team plans to add it at a later date.

blocks.cap: The Forgotten Hollow town. Take the upper-left door for the Cave Fairy Sanctuary, or the lower door with the potion sign for the Cave Fairy Department Store.

blocks.p: The front door is The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North, off The Forest North of Ellinia. The Ellinia quests track the disturbance to that tunnel. Welcome to the Hollow sends you down it. On the Hollow side, Forgotten Entrance III has the portal back up to the tunnel. From there, walk west through Forgotten Entrance II and I, then Primeval Forest III, II and I, to reach town.
There is a back door too. Sleepy Dungeon V has a way down into Forgotten Dungeon Tunnel. From there, The Faded Canopy and The End of Fleeting Light lead to town.
A Return Scroll to Forgotten Hollow takes you straight to town. Zelya gives you two for Natural Adhesive, and Luma sells them for 800 mesos.

Grendel the Really Old senses a magical disturbance from the Magic Library. Bring him 25 Luminous Magical Resonance vials from Lupins and he confirms it: an ancient seal has fractured, and something buried long ago is waking up. He sends you to Arwen the Fairy, because the fairies are native to the forest and feel the distress of the ancient woods.

Arwen uses Rotten Root Fragments from Cold Eyes as a tracking focus and traces the dark resonance to The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North. When you bring that news back, Grendel realizes an ancient barrier has been ripped open. That reveals the entrance to the Forgotten Hollow.
He asks you to go down and see what remains of the fairy homeland. At the bottom you meet Nyroth, an eccentric fairy who chose to stay behind in the dark decades ago.

Zelya is a cave fairy whose people once lived deep inside the cave. She drew a map to find her way back, then dropped it when Glowshrooms attacked her on a walk. The monsters tore it to pieces. You gather the fragments and bring Raffle Petals to piece it together. Then you clear the Aqumanders and Echopuses blocking her way home, but monsters keep pouring out from deeper in the cave.

Nyroth tries to Arcforge a protection scroll from Rafflesia Petals. The rot inside them swallows his forging fire, and all he gets is a Scorched Arcon Scroll. He decides the sickness is a living malice and sends you to the alchemist Jaime the Wandering Explorer in Decayed Tunnel III.
Jaime traces the rot to rusted iron in the soil, left over from Tristan's ancient battle with the Balrog. Clearing 50 Echopuses cleans the air. The living malice, Caligo, lies deeper.

Daniel the Scholar, a friendly mediator for the fairies, waits at the Precipice of Darkness. Caligo has consumed the Arcon. Daniel weaves an invisible Stasis Seal from Cursed Dolls and Duskmander Tails. It hides the fairies from Caligo's sight and stops the World Tree's roots from decaying, but it only buys time. You carry the warning back to Grendel, who is relieved the Cave Fairies survived. The Sages now have to prepare for the corrupted Arcon.

Deep in the cave, Myra grieves for her old companions. They have changed into the Myewoods nearby and the Sporewoods deeper in the cave, and she asks you to put them to rest. Her second quest sends you to her old friend Grendel in Ellinia with an Ominous Rotten Branch. He is deeply troubled by what is happening there.
The Hollow's story starts in Grendel's Magic Library with The Roots of Regret. The Sage's Burden and Myra's Old Friend both end there.

The ten new monsters run from level 39 (Glowshroom) to 59 (Sporewood). Rotten Mushmom is level 60. The quests open in steps: the Ellinia chain and Zelya's first two at 39, The Road Back Home at 43, Nyroth's chain at 45, Myra at 49 and Daniel at 50. Older monsters share the maps: Zombie Mushrooms, Zombie Lupins, Lupins, Curse Eyes, Evil Eyes and Fairies.

Fifteen quests in four chains, worth **84,249 EXP and 19,573 mesos** in total. The Ellinia chain comes first. Finishing Welcome to the Hollow opens the other three at once. You can run Zelya, Nyroth and Myra side by side as your level allows.

blocks.p:
**Where to farm each quest target:**
• **Lupins:** Monkey Swamp I (28 of 31)
• **Cold Eyes:** The Tunnel That Lost Light I (32 of 52)
• **Glowshrooms:** Forgotten Entrance III (19 of 44)
• **Raffles:** Forgotten Entrance II and III (14 each)
• **Aqumanders and Echopuses:** Primeval Forest II (17 of 19)
• **Rafflesias:** Forbidden Entrance (13)
• **Echopuses for A Memory of Iron:** Perilous Descent I and II (11 each)
• **Duskmanders:** Precipice of Darkness (14), next to Daniel
• **Myewoods:** Lingering Regret (9), where Myra stands
• **Sporewoods:** Another Sanctuary (7)

Forgotten Hollow itself is a town map with no monsters. Nyroth stands there next to an Arcane Station for Arcforge crafting. Two doors lead off it.
Zelya and Myen are in Cave Fairy Sanctuary.
Luma runs the grocery in Cave Fairy Department Store, the only shop in the Hollow. The Cave Fairy's Storage is in the same room. Luma's prices:

blocks.p: Rotten Mushmom only spawns in Someone Else's Grave, a hidden map off Decayed Tunnel I. She is an undead Mushmom, level 60 against the original's 40.

[[img:c090f6e4b73be2.png]]

table: Undead. Regenerates 864 HP per tick. Respawns every 1 to 1.5 hours

blocks.p: Her stat block has 752 P.DMG and 827 M.DMG. Those are base stats. What she hits you for depends on the attack she uses and your defenses. Bring a party and potions. We don't recommend soloing her without practice.

ul: Wizards split the Hollow by element. I/L Wizards get the lightning-weak Aqumander and Echopus plus the ice-weak Duskmander. F/P Wizards get Raffle, Rafflesia, Myewood and Sporewood, which are all weak to fire. Skip poison: Rafflesia, Duskmander, Rotten Mushroom and Sporewood resist it.
Clerics wreck the undead: Heal hurts Rotten Mushrooms, Sporewood and Rotten Mushmom.

Warriors fight up close, so touch damage matters. Myewood and Sporewood touch you for their base P.DMG (306 and 331). Their ranged attack uses 125% of P.DMG, so the projectile hits harder before defense.
